name: sub4me
description: The Sub4Me test customer (sample data): customers, invoices, contracts, offers, AI consumption, service tickets and a late-payment forecast for open invoices (needs the optional TabPFN service). Creating a ticket is the only write and goes to a demo table.

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo service tickets (Supabase).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a Sub4Me demo ticket (the only write; demo table).

tools.name: find_similar_tickets
tools.description: Before opening a ticket: find a note with a solution and the same issue in open tickets of any customer.

tools.name: link_ticket
tools.description: Let a customer follow an existing ticket or link a new ticket to it (demo link table).

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List the fictional Sub4Me customers with ids (Muster Industrie AG, Hanse Handelsgruppe AG).

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices and credit notes of a Sub4Me customer (sample data).

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: List the Sub4Me demo customer's contracts, filter by status (sample data).

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Offers SAP made to the Sub4Me demo customer: renewals and new products, filter by type or status (sample data).

tools.name: get_ai_consumption
tools.description: AI-unit consumption of the Sub4Me demo customer with forecast, by product and month, optional product or month filter (sample data).

tools.name: get_customer_overview
tools.description: Everything about the Sub4Me test customer in one answer: master data, contracts, offers, AI units, tickets and highlights (sample data).

tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.description: One Sub4Me product with its contracts, offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_contract
tools.description: One Sub4Me contract by id with notice deadline, renewal offers, consumption and tickets (sample data).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One SAP offer to the Sub4Me customer by id with the contract it renews (sample data).

tools.name: search_sub4me
tools.description: Free-text search across Sub4Me products, contracts, offers and tickets.

tools.name: enrich_ticket
tools.description: Enrich one Sub4Me service ticket with AI Control Tower context: contracts and AI-unit consumption of the product, other open tickets, related agents, risks with owner and mitigation, teams over budget, and next steps. Read-only; the links are a heuristic over sample data.

tools.name: predict_late_payments
tools.description: Forecast which open Sub4Me invoices will probably be paid more than 14 days late (TabPFN service, synthetic training data). Read only.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.

tabpfn_service_url.title: Late-payment forecast service
tabpfn_service_url.description: Optional. Address of services/tabpfn, for example http://127.0.0.1:8808 (https for anything not on this computer). Needed for predict_late_payments.

tabpfn_service_token.title: Forecast service token
tabpfn_service_token.description: Optional. Bearer token if the service was started with TABPFN_SERVICE_TOKEN. Stored as a secret.
